title: Adore You
lyrics:
Every little moment feels like something new
I found a thousand reasons just to stay with you
Through every changing season, I'll be standing true

title: Mercy
lyrics:
My heart is tired of fighting through the night
I'm searching for forgiveness in the fading light
A little mercy might help me make things right

title: Style
lyrics:
You walk into the room with a different kind of light
Some stories never fade, no matter how we try
We keep returning to the colors of the night

title: Habits
lyrics:
Old habits keep on calling when the evening falls
I'm trying to find the answers written on these walls
Some memories are louder than the silence in the hall

title: Don't Blame Me
lyrics:
Don't blame the stars for what we couldn't see
I crossed a thousand oceans just to feel free
Love has its own reasons, and so do you and me

title: Like A Stone
lyrics:
A quiet heart beneath a sky of grey
Like a stone, I watch the years drift away
Still searching for a place where I can stay

title: Stan
lyrics:
I wrote another letter that I never sent
A thousand thoughts and hours that I can't forget
The walls are closing in on everything I meant

title: Into You
lyrics:
The music gets louder whenever you're around
I feel the whole world spinning without making a sound
One more step and I might leave the ground

title: Everyday
lyrics:
Everyday brings another chance to start
A little bit of sunshine can repair a broken heart
The simplest moments are the greatest work of art

title: Apesar De Você
lyrics:
Apesar de você, ainda existe um novo dia
A esperança continua acesa em cada esquina
E ninguém pode apagar a força de quem caminha

title: Cálice
lyrics:
Há palavras escondidas no silêncio da cidade
Uma voz que busca espaço para dizer a verdade
Mesmo em tempos de sombra, permanece a liberdade

title: Ló Que Le Pasó a Hawaii
lyrics:
Las calles guardan historias que no pueden olvidar
La gente cuida sus raíces, su manera de soñar
Y aunque cambien los paisajes, siempre habrá un lugar

title: Airplanes
lyrics:
I keep looking at the sky, imagining a way
Maybe all my dreams are closer than they seem today
If I could change one moment, I'd still choose wish right now

title: Over Each Other
lyrics:
We're speaking different languages in the same room
Every little argument makes the silence bloom
I wish we could find a way to understand the truth

title: Take What You Want From Me
lyrics:
You left behind the pieces of a life we couldn't save
I gave you all my colors, but you turned them into grey
Now I'm finding strength in everything I gave

title: Raindance
lyrics:
The rain is falling softly on the streets tonight
We dance beneath the windows and forget about the time
Your smile makes every storm feel fine

title: Sprinter
lyrics:
Running through the city with the diamonds in the light
No time to look behind me, everything is moving fast
I'm chasing every dream until the moment lasts

title: Lover
lyrics:
Twenty years or twenty seconds, time can disappear
Every road feels like home whenever you are near
I'll keep choosing you through every changing year

title: Nothin' On You
lyrics:
I've seen a thousand faces in a thousand different places
But none can match the beauty that your presence embraces
The whole world shines, but you still light my days
